name: Cheese Custard
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Put the seasonings and the eggs into a saucepan and beat thoroughly
Add the milk and stir in the cheese
Put over the fire and stir constantly until it begins to thicken and coat the spoon
Take at once from the fire, and pour over soda biscuits, strips of buttered toast, or shredded wheat biscuits arranged on a hot platter

source.originalInstructions:
1. Put the seasonings and the eggs into a saucepan and beat thoroughly
2. Add the milk and stir in the cheese
3. Put over the fire and stir constantly until it begins to thicken and coat the spoon
4. Take at once from the fire, and pour over soda biscuits, strips of buttered toast, or shredded wheat biscuits arranged on a hot platter
